tagline_en: Gentle plant-peptide cream that soothes and repairs
tagline_zh: 温和补水 · 清爽不油腻
overview_en: Contains natural plant extracts, oat peptides and hyaluronic acid that support skin-cell repair; gentle and suitable for all skin types, it soothes, calms and rebuilds damaged skin while maintaining moisture.
overview_zh: 含天然植物提取物、燕麦胜肽与玻尿酸，帮助修复肌肤细胞；温和适合任何肤质，提供舒缓、镇静、修复受损肌肤，深层渗透至肌底层，保持水分，预防脱水。
